dict.string: LifeOS needs camera access to scan food barcodes.
LifeOS needs photo library access to select food images for AI meal scanning.
LifeOS reads your health data to display fitness and wellness insights.
LifeOS writes health data to keep your records up to date.
LifeOS listens when you tap Say so you can log a meal by speaking, like "two rotis and dal".
LifeOS turns what you say into text to log meals. It runs on your iPhone when the iPhone supports it.
